plan.models: Existing GigaAM-v3 INT8 RU, Parakeet600M v2 INT8 EN, Whisper tiny LID
plan.normalization: NFKC, lowercase, ё->е, punctuation ignored, apostrophes retained; NO number expansion or acronym equivalences
conditions: current cached production cuts + AUTO routing
same current cuts + forced known language (diagnostic)
production ChunkPlanner.plan fixed ~18s, complete audio + forced language (diagnostic, not app modification)
plan.references: Published Veche CSV, AMI manual words, four user supplied scripts; no generated hypotheses used as reference
plan.scope: Host CPU, real production Java chunk builder, features and nearby-language fallback; Python ORT/sherpa execute bundled models. Not physical Android, not full UI/export verification.
plan.overlap: No reference words removed. Single stream ordering can inflate meeting WER during overlap.
plan.changes: No models/app/ASR/chunk-boundary implementation changed; alternate cuts are evaluation only
